title: File:A member of the RAF Regiment taking part in the RAF Downhill Championships MOD 45158943.jpg
desc:
Pictured is a member of RAF Halton's personnel taking part in the RAF Downhill Championships as part of the Aston Hill 'Mash Up' downhill race at Aston Hill Park near RAF Halton.  
The rider, a  member of the RAF Regiment negotiates jumps, drops, and roots on a challenging route.

Organization: RAF

title: File:RAF Cycling Association Downhill Inter-Station Race MOD 45160298.jpg
desc:
Pictured is a participant in the RAF Cycling Association Downhill Inter-Station Race at Descend Bike Park, Hamsterley Forest, County Durham.
The aim of the event is to improve Downhill race skills for aspiring racers at grassroots level as well as encourage the sport of cycle racing to RAF personnel
